content.value: Consider the following undirected graph as a water line network connecting five (11) [CO4] neighborhoods: A, B, C, D,E. The.city wants to design a backup plane in case the cheapest pipeline link is unavailable. Design the second-best network, explain your choice of edges and compute the total cost.
